decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1.	Due to the design, positioning and bulk of the extension, the proposal is inconsistent with the character of the street scene and conservation area. The development fails to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the conservation area and is therefore contrary to the provisions of Policy ENV B.2.2 - Conservation Areas of the London Borough of Hounslow's Unitary Development Plan and Section 8.0 - Development in Conservation Areas, of the Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - 2.	Due to the bulk and close proximity of the proposed extension to the neighbouring property the development will have an overbearing effect on the adjoining residents and will cause harm to the existing level of residential amenity. The proposal is thus considered contrary to the provisions of Policies ENV B.1.1 - New Development and H.6.4 - Extensions and Alterations of the London Borough of Hounslow's Unitary Development Plan.
description: Amendment to existing planning application 647/382/P3 to move existing entrance and addition of an integral garage to ground floor of existing dwellinghouse.
